evidence.quote: The Sustainable Finance team is responsible for the environmental indicators of the production sites. Water-related indicators are reported monthly by each production site’s Environment manager using the PURE Platform tool, which was introduced in 2018 alongside UL EHS Sustainability. Danone tracks environmental performance using an operational control approach. In 2025, all 151 of Danone’s production sites reported environmental indicators. Tertiary buildings (offices, research centers, etc.) are excluded from the reporting scope because their water use is very small compared to production sites. If buildings such as offices or warehouses are located within or adjacent to these sites and their water use cannot be excluded, it is included in the site’s total withdrawals.
